commands.command: python3 PIL alpha validation for prepared assets
commands.notes: Confirmed all four prepared assets have alpha channels and transparent corners.

commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
for path in sorted(Path('art_candidates/phase3e/prepared').glob('*.png')):
    im = Image.open(path)
    assert 'A' in im.getbands(), path
    alpha = im.getchannel('A')
    corners = [alpha.getpixel(pt) for pt in [(0,0),(im.width-1,0),(0,im.height-1),(im.width-1,im.height-1)]]
    assert all(v == 0 for v in corners), (path, corners)
print('alpha ok')
PY
commands.notes: Final alpha validation passed for all prepared assets.

json.load(open('art_candidates/phase3e/prepared_manifest.json'))
